docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Darwin's argument for evolution by natural selection, in the sixth edition.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Charles Darwin (1809–1882), On the Origin of Species, 1859, the sixth edition of 1872. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
